name: Mary Steele
bioAdditions: She is probably not James Pringle's wife at all. The 'second marriage' to Mary Steele comes from a merged FamilySearch profile of James Pringle (KP7T-1HK). That profile has absorbed a Scottish James and Mary Pringle, whose son Thomas Murray Pringle married at Toronto in 1867, and the 'Mary' has then been identified with Mary Steele (S1). FamilySearch's own profile of Mary Steele (1808-1876) makes her the wife of John Linskill (d. 1865). It shows her as the mother of six Linskill children born in Lehman Twp between 1833 and 1848, living as 'Mary Linchkill' in 1860, and buried as Mary Steele Linskill at Huntsville, Jackson Twp (S2). Through her parents, Peter Steele and Charity Lamoreaux, she was James Pringle's first cousin. No record of a marriage to James was found. Recommendation: remove her as James's spouse (see I282608053719).
